summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K and Exhibit 99.1 press release on June 15, 2026, announcing results of its annual and special meeting of shareholders. The five director nominees were elected, with Ari Sussman receiving 99.667% for, Ashwath Mehra 99.912%, Angela María Orozco Gómez 99.385%, Jasper Bertisen 99.832%, and María Constanza García Botero 99.836%. This is a routine meeting result; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or forced management change occurred. The filing does not contain deal terms.
